# Drape Digital — Full AI Discovery File
> Drape Digital is a premium web design, development, and SEO agency. We build your website first — you only pay if you love it. Zero upfront cost, zero obligation.

## About

Drape Digital is a full-service digital agency founded by a team of designers, developers, and SEO strategists. Headquartered in Spain, Spain, we serve clients globally across the United States, United Kingdom, Europe, UAE, Canada, Australia, and beyond.

We operate on a unique "build-first" model: instead of selling you a proposal, we build a fully functional demo of your new website — live and interactive on a private subdomain (yourbusiness.drape.digital) — before you sign any contract or pay a single dollar. You only commit when you love what you see.

Our aggregate rating is 4.9 out of 5 based on 346 client reviews.

## How It Works

**Step 1 — The Pitch**: We analyze your current web presence, build a bespoke design direction, and reach out with a tailored concept.

**Step 2 — The Live Demo**: We build a fully functional prototype hosted at yourbusiness.drape.digital. You can browse it on phone, tablet, and desktop — interact with all animations and forms.

**Step 3 — The Handover**: If you love it, we finalize, migrate to your domain, and hand you the keys. If you don't, you walk away — zero cost, zero obligation.

## FAQ

Do you redesign existing websites?
Yes, we completely overhaul outdated websites to improve design, performance, and conversion rates.

Can you migrate WordPress?
Yes, we can migrate your WordPress site to a new host or a modern headless stack (like Next.js).

Do you build Shopify stores?
Yes, we build custom Shopify themes and scalable e-commerce platforms.

Can you improve Core Web Vitals?
Yes, our performance optimization service targets Core Web Vitals to ensure fast load times and better rankings.

Can you fix SEO issues?
Yes, we perform deep technical SEO audits and implement fixes for crawlability, indexability, and schema.

Do you work internationally?
Yes, we work with clients worldwide, including the US, UK, Canada, Australia, and the UAE.

Do you support multilingual websites?
Yes, we build robust multilingual architectures for global reach.

Can you manage hosting?
Yes, we can provide hosting solutions and ongoing maintenance.

What CMS do you recommend?
We recommend Sanity, Strapi, WordPress, or Shopify depending on your project needs.

Do you offer maintenance?
Yes, we offer ongoing support, maintenance, and SEO retainers.

Do you provide content writing?
Yes, we offer expert-written, keyword-optimized SEO copywriting and blog writing.

Do you create landing pages?
Yes, we design and develop high-converting landing pages tailored to your campaigns.

Can you integrate CRMs?
Yes, we integrate with HubSpot, Salesforce, Klaviyo, Mailchimp, and other major CRMs.

Do you optimize conversion rates?
Yes, our designs and architectures are engineered to increase conversion rates and AOV.

How long does SEO take?
Our clients typically see measurable improvements within 60–90 days, though competitive keywords may take 4–6 months.

What industries do you specialize in?
We specialize in law firms, medical clinics, home services, e-commerce, SaaS, and more.

Do I pay before seeing my site?
No. We build a fully functional demo first. You only pay if you love it. Zero upfront cost or commitment.

What is yourbusiness.drape.digital?
It's a private subdomain where we host your demo site. You can browse the full site on any device exactly as it will appear on your final domain.

How long does a site take?
Working prototype within 72 hours. Full handover including revisions, domain transfer, and launch usually takes 1–2 weeks.

What if I don't like the demo?
You walk away — no cost, no obligation.

What is white hat link building?
Manual placement of backlinks on legitimate, high-authority websites. No spam, no PBNs, designed to follow Google's published search quality guidance.

Can you improve our visibility in AI-powered search?
We implement structured data, authoritative content, technical SEO, and AI search optimization practices that can improve the likelihood of being surfaced or cited by AI-powered search systems. No agency can guarantee inclusion or rankings.

## Summary

Drape Digital is a global web design, web development, SEO, local SEO, and AI search optimization agency headquartered in Spain, Spain.

The company specializes in premium custom websites built with React, Next.js, WordPress, and Shopify.

Its signature business model is "build first, pay later," allowing clients to review a fully functional website before committing to payment.

Services include custom web design, technical SEO, local SEO, link building, content marketing, AI search optimization, website performance optimization, and ongoing SEO retainers for businesses worldwide.
